current_price.description: Accepted price active at the current time.

effective_at.description: The first accepted price is effective from the start of the current UTC day. A replacement becomes effective at the start of the next UTC day.

expires_at.description: The exclusive per-agreement expiration timestamp. Publisher opt-out schedules it for the start of the next UTC month. Zone-wide grace is represented by the zone configuration expires_at instead.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/pay-per-use/.description: Accepts or rejects the pending pay-per-use price proposal identified by price_id in the request body. Acceptance requires an enabled operator with a verified name, an enabled publisher zone, and matching billing classifications; rejection remains available for cleanup.

price_id.description: Pending pay-per-use price id returned in the operator proposal queue.

POST /zones/{zone_id}/pay-per-use/operat.description: Proposes a required price, withdraws a pending proposal, accepts an operator's default pay-per-use price, or resumes an accepted price before its scheduled expiry. Propose, accept_default, and resume require an enabled operator with a verified name, an enabled publisher zone, and matching billing classifications.

price_usd_microcents.description: Price in microcents. Must be a multiple of 100,000 ($0.001) between $0.001 and $9,999.999.
